summary: Amass Brands filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment and restatement of its Series C Convertible Preferred Stock certificate of designation on August 19, 2026, approved by preferred holders and the board. The amendment revises liquidation provisions, conversion rights and pricing (particularly for limited conversion events), redemption provisions, clarifies no mandatory redemption except upon liquidation, and updates event-of-default terms and covenants. The filing also references a securities purchase agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC dated March 17, 2026. This is a financing-structure modification, not a traditional special situation; watch for potential conversion overhang or dilution effects on common stock.
